sample_reviews: Beware : Fraud App don't use this app.

CRED gives good cashback, but customer support is frustrating. No support phone number. After several UPI failures, the chatbot blocked me from reaching an agent. I posted a review here and sent email reminders; Cred agent called after 12 days of failed transactions . " Call me " link is hidden under “Miscellaneous”, followed by irrelevant options like vehicle inspection and KYC. Even “Call me now” leads to more steps and uploads. Good cashback doesn't justify such poor support accessibility.
